title: Actual RGO backward kernel recovery and KL input budget

target_statement: For probability base mu on finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel E, precision b>=0, center u and a>0, put rho=mu.tilted(-b/2*norm(x-u)^2). Construct one Markov kernel K, before all input laws nu and budgets r, whose every fiber equals rho.tilted(-norm(x-y)^2/(2*a)) and equals the base tilt with precision b+a^-1 and center (b+a^-1)^-1*(b*u+a^-1*y). Prove K composed with actual GaussianSmoothing rho sqrt(a) equals rho. For every probability nu and r>=0 with actual quadratic transportCost(nu,rho)<=ofReal(r^2), prove actual klDiv(K composed with GaussianSmoothing nu sqrt(a),rho)<=ofReal(r^2/(2*a)).
